_comment: Known tSearch portals, one machine per entry.
The ISO is portal-agnostic: the guest talks to a host bridge over COM2 and
knows nothing about which portal it is. Everything that differs between
users lives on the HOST — which corpus URL to fetch, which credential to
use, and where the resulting private data is cached. So a 'version per
portal' is a per-portal bridge profile, not a per-portal kernel build.
auth=basic entries need a keychain credential before they can sync;
scripts/make-portal.sh prints the exact command and never handles the
